- Forensics: we need a defined process (who to contact, SLA for evidence requests). Sample language suggested: "Redwood will acknowledge evidence requests within 4 business hours and provide alternative timeline if additional supplier approvals are required."

Subject: Re: Cross-Functional Weekly: open asks and next steps

Elena / team — technical input below. Keeping it short:

- Retention: 60-day retention for cached prompt material is feasible if we enable an opt-in per-tenant cache TTL override during provisioning. Impact: small increase in storage churn; no extra infra SLA risk. Implementation ETA: config flag + deploy in 2 sprints (approx. 3 weeks) unless Aurelia needs it sooner — we can ship a contractual acceptance and schedule feature rollout as part of the onboarding plan.
- Forensics / evidence requests: we can commit to an acknowledgement within 4 business hours. For full-forensics delivery (logs, packet captures) we need to define scope; typical delivery SLA is 5 business days depending on data volume and legal approvals. Proposed contractual language: "Redwood will acknowledge forensics requests within 4 business hours and provide an estimated completion timeline; full data extracts will target 5 business days subject to compliance review."

I'll prepare a short tech note to insert into the SOW v3. ETA: tech note by 2028-04-11 16:00 PT.

Karthik
